question: Octaves of Newland, respectively, begin with _______, and end with _______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** H; Th.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Newlands’ Law of Octaves (1865): Arranged elements in order of increasing atomic weights.
 
• Octaves concept: Every eighth element had similar chemical properties, like the octave in music.
 
• First element of the octaves:** Hydrogen (H)**
 
• Last element of the octaves: **Thorium (Th)**
